brief.summary_1line: Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana reach Mount Chitrakuta, admire its beauty, meet Valmiki, and build and consecrate a forest hermitage to live in exile.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana stand before the lush slopes of Mount Chitrakuta filled with flowering trees, birds, and wandering elephants.
Lakshmana builds a leaf‑thatched forest hut from freshly cut wood while Rama and Sita watch in the shade of tall trees.
Rama performs sacred rites before entering the new hut, offering prayers and meat from a black antelope at small altars facing the eight directions.
